doc.title: Scott Jimmy — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: Choosing songs with LiPuma
summary: He and Tommy created the songs together with no material imposed.

story.theme_name: Writing and arranging: how musicians compose
story.community_name: Writing, arranging and composing: how the music gets made

blocks.x: Tell about – again, the – when, in picking out the tunes and all, was that a happy experience? Were you involved artistically in the making of that album?
So nobody imposed material on you that you don’t want to do.
No. We created the songs, myself and Tommy, with his suggestions and his ideas. He put it over beautifully. I got to give it to him.
